resolvedFindings.finding: b355 unit 7 net energy mislabeled annual mean
resolvedFindings.resolution: Title now describes annual net heat balance.

resolvedFindings.finding: b353 Celsius and b364 Coulomb notation collision
resolvedFindings.resolution: Temperature inputs use degC; charge uses C. Absolute-temperature sensitivities use +1 degree, not a percentage of Celsius zero.

resolvedFindings.finding: b366 unit 7 efficiency exceeding unity under sensitivity
resolvedFindings.resolution: Perturbation is .95 -> .96; round-trip results remain 89.3% and 90.24%.

resolvedFindings.finding: b366 unit 9 missing daily energy unit
resolvedFindings.resolution: Input is kWh/day; output is cycles/day.

limitations: The peer review checks the stated reduced teaching models, not fitness for railway design, construction, operating permission or professional certification.
Dimensional propagation does not automatically prove physical completeness or all unit-scale conversion choices; model relationships and notable conversions also received manual review.

Primary source identity, selected dates and topic scope were verified. Direct retrieval limits and indexed-metadata substitutions are recorded; no exhaustive review of every linked standard or full paper is claimed.
All numerical inputs are original classroom assumptions. They are not presented as measured results of the named landmark projects.
Generated catalog/UI integration is owned and tested separately by root.
